title: Auto-promote remux fallback after pilot gate
summary: Make the backend automatically apply current-queue remux file overrides once three same-series TV episodes have proven oversized encode fallback remux behavior.
reason: The existing pilot promotion command validates and writes the right overrides, but it requires an explicit WebView/API action. In a live long-series run, the pipeline continues encoding each episode before falling back because no backend process submits the promotion after the third completed fallback row.
behavior_before: After three fallback-remux episodes completed, no automatic override write occurred; the current run continued routing later episodes through encode before fallback remux.
behavior_after: A backend-owned monitor detects the completed-manifest evidence gate during a live API session and reuses the existing remux pilot promotion machinery to write exact current-queue routing.profile=remux overrides for remaining eligible rows.
